Compare two snapshots, or a snapshot with the live state

Source: R/snapshot-diff.R
snapshot_diff.Rd

Reports what changed between two snapshots (or between a snapshot and the project's current grading state): rubric items added, removed, reworded, re-pointed or regrouped, groups added, removed, renamed or re-bounded, scoring changes; per-repository selection, public comment and private note changes; per-pair score deltas and every repository's total before and after; and template questions added, removed, renamed or changed.

Usage

snapshot_diff(
  from,
  to = "current",
  project = ".",
  part = c("rubric", "marks", "template")
)

Arguments

from

A snapshot reference (see snapshot_info()).

to

A snapshot reference, or "current" (the default) for the live state.

project

Path to the project directory. Defaults to the working directory.

part

Which parts to compare: any of "rubric", "marks", "template". Scores are always compared.

Value

A markermd_snapshot_diff object. Its rubric, marks, scores, totals and template properties are data frames.

Details

Rubric items and groups are matched across the two sides by the database ids a snapshot records, so an item reworded or a group relabeled in mark() is reported as a rename. A replace import mints new ids; items it re-created are matched as a likely rename when they keep their points and are selected by the same repositories on both sides. Selections are compared by item id as well, so a reworded item is not a selection change while a deleted item whose description another item took over still is. Questions are matched by the ids of the two sides' templates, so a question renamed in between is compared with itself under its newer name, and only the template comparison reports the rename.

The comparison is only meaningful when the snapshot's part is present on both sides; a part left out is reported as unchanged.

See also

snapshot_scores(), snapshot_restore()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# What did everything since the latest snapshot change?
snapshot_diff("latest", project = "hw01")

# What did the last import change?
snapshot_diff(-1, "latest", project = "hw01")
} # }
